DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). 

Given the MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement and the clinical presentation of gait and limb ataxia, this is highly characteristic of PML. I will proceed with this diagnosis.
